مُصْرِمٌ A possessor of a صِرْمَة of camels. (TA.) ―
-b2- And [hence], as also ↓ أَصْرَمُ , (M, K,) Having little property: (M:) or poor, [and] having a numerous household, or family. (K.) One says, كَلَأٌ تِيجَعُ مِنْهُ كَبِدُ المُصْرِمِ [Herbage by reason of which the liver of him who has little property is pained]; i. e., abundant, so that when he who has little property sees it, he grieves that he has not many camels which he may pasture upon it. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
